import os.path
import sqlite3
import tkinter as tk
import cv2
import numpy as np

import os

# 颜色直方图特征提取函数
def color_histogram_features(image):
    # 将图像转换为 RGB 颜色空间
    hsv = cv2.cvtColor(image, cv2.COLOR_BGR2HSV)
    # 获取 HSV 图像的第 0 个和第 1 个通道
    channels = [0, 1]
    # 建立在 HSV 颜色空间中 Hue 的取值范围为 0~180, Saturation 的取值范围为 0~256
    hist_size = [180, 256]
    # Hue 的取值范围为 0~180
    hue_range = [0, 180]
    # Saturation 的取值范围为 0~256
    saturation_range = [0, 256]
    # 按照前面定义的参数计算 HSV 图像的直方图
    hist = cv2.calcHist([hsv], channels, None, hist_size, [hue_range, saturation_range])
    # 对得到的直方图进行归一化处理
    cv2.normalize(hist, hist)
    # 返回直方图
    return hist.flatten()

BASE_DIR = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
db_path = os.path.join(BASE_DIR, "database.db")
connect = sqlite3.connect(db_path)

# 创建数据库连接
def create_database_connection():
    conn = sqlite3.connect('database.db')
    conn.execute("CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS images (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, image TEXT, features TEXT)")
    return conn

# 创建数据库表
def create_database_table(conn):
    conn.execute("CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS images (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, image TEXT, features TEXT)")

# 连接数据库并查询数据
def connect_database(conn):
    cursor = conn.execute("SELECT image, features FROM images")
    result = cursor.fetchall()
    return result

# 将数据集中的图像特征向量存储到数据库中
def store_database(conn, images):
    for image, feature in images:
        cursor = conn.execute("REPLACE INTO images (image, features) VALUES (?, ?)", (image, feature))
        conn.commit()

# 查询数据库中所有图像的特征向量
def query_database(conn):
    cursor = conn.execute("SELECT features FROM images")
    result = cursor.fetchall()
    return result

from tkinter import filedialog

def create_GUI_interface(conn):
    root = tk.Tk()
    root.title("图像检索系统")
    root.geometry("400x300")

    label1 = tk.Label(root, text="选择图像文件夹：")
    label1.pack()

    input_box = tk.Entry(root)
    input_box.pack()

    def browse_path():
        folder_path = filedialog.askdirectory()
        input_box.delete(0, tk.END)
        input_box.insert(0, folder_path)

    browse_button = tk.Button(root, text="浏览", command=browse_path)
    browse_button.pack()

    label2 = tk.Label(root, text="选择目标图像：")
    label2.pack()

    def select_target_image():
        target_image_path = filedialog.askopenfilename(title="选择目标图像")
        target_box.delete(0, tk.END)
        target_box.insert(0, target_image_path)

    target_button = tk.Button(root, text="选择目标图像", command=select_target_image)
    target_button.pack()

    target_box = tk.Entry(root)
    target_box.pack()

    def get_similar_images():
        target_image_path = target_box.get()
        folder_path = input_box.get()

        # 加载目标图像
        target_image = cv2.imread(target_image_path)

        # 计算目标图像的颜色特征
        target_features = color_histogram_features(target_image)

        # 将图像文件夹中的所有图像和其特征向量添加到数据库中
        add_images_to_database(folder_path, conn)

        # 连接到特征数据库并查询所有图像的颜色特征
        all_features = connect_database(conn)

        # 计算目标图像与所有图像的欧式距离
        distances = []
        for image, feature in all_features:
            feature = np.fromstring(feature, dtype=float, sep=' ')
            distance = cv2.compareHist(target_features, feature, cv2.HISTCMP_CHISQR)
            distances.append((image, distance))

        # 根据欧式距离的大小对所有图像进行排序，并返回最相似的前五张图像
        distances.sort(key=lambda x: x[1])
        similar_images = distances[:5]

        # 输出结果到控制台
        for image, distance in similar_images:
            print(f"Image {image} is {distance} away from the target image.")

    submit_button = tk.Button(root, text="查询", command=get_similar_images)
    submit_button.pack()

    close_button = tk.Button(root, text="关闭", command=root.quit)
    close_button.pack()

    message = tk.Message(root, text="颜色特征信息已储存到数据库中！")
    message.pack()

    root.mainloop()


def add_images_to_database(folder_path, conn):
    for root, dirs, files in os.walk(folder_path):
        for file_name in files:
            file_path = os.path.join(root, file_name)
            image = cv2.imread(file_path)
            features = color_histogram_features(image)
            conn.execute("REPLACE INTO images (image, features) VALUES (?, ?)", (file_path, np.array2string(features)))
            conn.commit()

create_GUI_interface(connect)
connect.close()将颜色提取中选择的两个通道改为三通道，修改后，输出完整系统代码
